title: Create a session
intro: Here's how to add a session manually in Sessionboard.

steps.narration: Open the Sessions module and click Submissions.
In the top right, click Add Session.
Fill in the session details — at minimum a title and a status, which are required.
Switch to the Participants tab to add speakers, moderators, or chairpersons. If someone isn't listed, create them in Contacts first.
Click Add Session to save. Your session now appears in the Sessions module.
To add custom field data, open the session with the pencil icon and scroll to your custom fields at the bottom.
